Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap of what we showed and the areas you said mattered most: 

- Real-time inference at <100ms p95 for your 1k/s burst patterns (important for your search UX)
- Cost control levers: multi-quantization profiles + smart routing to lower-cost pools for non-interactive workloads
- Prefix/KV cache to avoid re-computation on repeated prompts from your microservices

Where we landed on fit: you signaled interest in a scoped pilot to validate latency and cost improvements in one of your product verticals (search results re-ranking). You also mentioned procurement needs a short SOW and a one-page cost estimate.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) 15-min alignment call next week to lock scope & timeline (I can do Tue/Wed afternoon PT)
2) We provision a 2-week pilot (we can offer pilot credits) and a short checklist for required access
3) If this isn’t a fit, a quick reply with “not now” helps us close the loop — totally fine either way.

I’ve copied Marissa from Solutions Engineering to help scope the pilot if you want option (2). If you share an approximate procurement timeline we’ll draft a minimal SOW and cost range to speed approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.
